detail.longDescription: It was just a matter of time but that's it, # codingame is now fully giving up to # LLMs . Although it isn't forbidden for participants to code by hand, their new challenge API allows to directly plug a coding agent onto it to participate on your behalf, and they explicitly encourage you to do so. The funny part is that the first challenge with this new API started yesterday, and so far it looks like it's a disaster, people on the forum complaining it's full of bugs and not working. Maybe they vibecoded it ? 🙃 The beginning of the end for what has been a really wonderful place to learn programming. 🪦 # noai # fuckai # programming
